en_title: Naruto Teasers Reveal New Shadow Rising Manga and Anime Crossover Series
cn_title: 《火影忍者》新漫画与联动动画亮相
subtitle: 两大忍者作品相遇
opus_summary: 《火影忍者》公布岸本齐史参与的新漫画，以及与《忍空》联动的动画，两部作品均放出先导预告。动画正在制作，由两位原作者监修；新漫画将在明年的跳跃庆典公布更多消息。

paragraphs.en: Naruto is alive and well, as author Masashi Kishimoto has announced a new manga called Shadow Rising – and a new anime crossover series is on the way, too.
paragraphs.cn: 《火影忍者》依然活跃：作者岸本齐史公布了名为《Shadow Rising》的新漫画，一部联动动画也即将到来。

paragraphs.en: Both Naruto projects were announced during the Naruto panel at New York Comic Con 2026. Details about the manga, specifically, were light, with only Kishimoto's involvement and its "Shadow Rising" title confirmed for now.
paragraphs.cn: 这两个《火影忍者》项目均在2026年纽约漫展的《火影忍者》专场公布。其中，新漫画披露的信息很少，目前仅确认岸本齐史参与，以及作品名为《Shadow Rising》。

paragraphs.en: The panel did come with more information about that anime series, though. Aptly titled "Naruto x Ninku," the show will serve as a full-on crossover between Naruto and popular '90s manga and anime franchise Ninku . Both the show and the manga did receive teaser trailers, which you can see below.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，专场披露了更多关于这部动画的信息。作品名为《Naruto x Ninku》，可谓名副其实，将让《火影忍者》与20世纪90年代人气漫画及动画系列《忍空》全面联动。动画和漫画都发布了先导预告，可在下方观看。

paragraphs.en: A teaser for new NARUTO manga by Masashi Kishimoto is here!
paragraphs.cn: 岸本齐史的《火影忍者》新漫画先导预告来了！

paragraphs.en: Stay tuned for more updates at the NARUTO Super Stage at Jump Festa 2027!
paragraphs.cn: 敬请关注Jump Festa 2027的《火影忍者》超级舞台，届时将有更多消息！
两大传奇忍者系列相遇。

paragraphs.en: Fully supervised by Koji Kiriyama and Masashi Kishimoto, NARUTO x NINKŪ is in production!
paragraphs.cn: 由桐山光侍和岸本齐史全程监修的《Naruto x Ninku》正在制作中！

paragraphs.en: Character Designer / Chief Animation Director: Tetsuya Nishio
paragraphs.cn: 角色设计／总作画监督：西尾铁也

paragraphs.en: "Team 7 members Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura are given a mission by Kakashi," an official description for Naruto x Ninku said. "Since Kakashi cannot participate himself, Naruto is appointed acting leader. As a result of this decision, Naruto is fully motivated to make the mission a success. However, on the way, Team 7 finds themselves lost in another world. What appears before the bewildered trio is a boy with a face resembling a frog’s, named Fūsuke. What awaits them in this strange new world?"
paragraphs.cn: 《Naruto x Ninku》的官方简介写道：「第七班的鸣人、佐助和小樱接到了卡卡西交付的任务。由于卡卡西无法亲自参与，鸣人被任命为代理队长。这个决定让鸣人干劲十足，一心要完成任务。然而，第七班在途中迷失到了另一个世界。出现在不知所措的三人面前的，是一个长着青蛙般面孔、名叫风助的少年。在这个陌生的新世界里，等待他们的会是什么？」

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, as reported by Variety , the Naruto panel also came with a surprise update on the live-action movie . Amid rumors of early plot details and casting decisions, director Destin Daniel Cretton shared a message where he explained "what an honor it is to bring Kishimoto-sensei's incredible world and characters to life."
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，据《综艺》报道，《火影忍者》专场还意外带来了真人电影的新消息。正值初步剧情细节和选角传闻流传之际，导演Destin Daniel Cretton发来寄语，表示「能将岸本老师笔下精彩的世界与角色搬上银幕，是多么荣幸的事」。

paragraphs.en: "The further we get into making this film, the more excited I am about what we’re creating," he continued. "What I’ve always loved about Naruto is that he’s the character who might normally get sidelined as a sidekick. He’s excitable, he tries too hard, and people underestimate him. But he has an incredible heart. No matter how many times he fails or gets knocked down, he never stops believing in himself or fighting for the people he loves. That spirit is at the heart of the story we’re telling.
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说道：「随着电影制作不断推进，我对我们正在创作的作品也越来越兴奋。我一直喜爱鸣人的一点是，像他这样的角色，通常可能只会被安排当配角，放在一边。他容易激动，努力得有些过头，人们也低估他。但他有一颗无比真挚的心。无论失败多少次、被击倒多少次，他始终相信自己，也始终为所爱的人而战。这种精神正是我们所讲述故事的核心。

paragraphs.en: "These characters mean so much to so many people, myself included, and I carry that with me as we make this film. We’re approaching the world, relationships, and journeys Kishimoto-sensei created with a lot of care, and we want to capture what makes NARUTO so special. We’re hard at work and will have more to share soon. Until then, thank you for your passion, your patience, and for being along for the ride. I can’t wait for you to see what’s ahead!"
paragraphs.cn: 「这些角色对许多人而言意义非凡，我也是其中之一，拍摄这部电影时，我始终铭记这一点。我们十分用心地对待岸本老师创造的世界、人物关系与旅程，希望呈现出《火影忍者》的独特之处。我们正在努力制作，很快就会分享更多消息。在此之前，感谢大家的热情、耐心和一路相伴。我迫不及待想让大家看到接下来的内容！」

paragraphs.en: A description in the YouTube upload for Shadow Rising promised more details will be shared at the Naruto Super Stage at Jump Festa 2027. The Naruto x Ninku upload , meanwhile, confirmed that the show is in production with supervision from Kishimoto and Ninku author Koji Kiriyama, with the Naruto X/Twitter account confirming Noriyuki Abe as its director and Tetsuya Nishio as its character designer/chief animation director. Release date details remain a mystery for now.
paragraphs.cn: 《Shadow Rising》的YouTube视频简介承诺，将在Jump Festa 2027的《火影忍者》超级舞台公布更多详情。与此同时，《Naruto x Ninku》的视频简介确认，动画正在制作，由岸本齐史和《忍空》作者桐山光侍监修。《火影忍者》的X账号还确认，阿部记之担任导演，西尾铁也担任角色设计兼总作画监督。具体推出日期目前仍未公布。
